spec.description: Visão quase em tempo real de NetFlow Huawei: taxa estimada por minuto a partir de buckets do fim do fluxo (amostragem/sampling), GeoLite2 offline e atualização Grafana de 30s. Não é captura instantânea nem detector de ataque.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),protocol AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes)*8/60,3) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,protocol ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket_utc AS 'Minuto UTC',protocol AS Protocolo,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes)*8/60,3) AS 'Taxa estimada',ROUND(SUM(total_packets)/60,1) AS 'Pacotes/s',SUM(flow_records) AS 'Fluxos' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY bucket_utc,protocol ORDER BY bucket_utc DESC LIMIT 60

spec.title: Mapa de tráfego observado — GeoLite2 (não são alertas)
spec.description: Origens públicas observadas no NetFlow Huawei, localizadas aproximadamente pela GeoLite2. Não são alertas nem locais exatos. A atualização depende da importação nfcapd → MariaDB.

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.latitude,t.longitude,COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.ips AS 'IPs de origem',t.vol AS 'Volume' FROM (SELECT src_latitude AS latitude,src_longitude AS longitude,src_asn AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_latitude IS NOT NULL AND src_longitude IS NOT NULL GROUP BY src_latitude,src_longitude,src_asn ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 300) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

spec.title: Países e origens observadas
spec.description: País e coordenadas aproximados da base GeoLite2 para IPs públicos

spec.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') AS 'País',t.ips AS 'IPs de origem',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT src_country AS pais,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_country<>'' GROUP BY src_country ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 20) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

spec.title: Taxa estimada por interface Huawei (entrada)
spec.description: Interfaces SNMP ifName confirmadas; 'Não informado' corresponde ao ifIndex 0. A direção bruta do NetFlow não corresponde necessariamente a upload/download.

spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),CASE WHEN input_if=0 THEN 'sem interface (0)' ELSE COALESCE(CONCAT(im.if_name,' (',input_if,')'),CONCAT('ifIndex ',input_if,' (sem nome)')) END AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes)*8/60,3) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute AS p LEFT JOIN orby_interface_names AS im ON im.source=p.source AND im.if_index=p.input_if WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,p.input_if,im.if_name ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(bucket_utc,'1m'),protocol AS metric,ROUND(SUM(total_packets)/60,1) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) GROUP BY 1,protocol ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Top 20 ASNs observados (ASN, nome, blocos, país)

spec.rawSql: SELECT t.asn AS 'ASN',t.nome AS 'Nome',t.blocos AS 'Blocos / IPs',t.ips AS 'IPs',CASE WHEN t.paises>1 THEN 'Vários' ELSE COALESCE(cn.name,NULLIF(t.pais,''),'Não informado') END AS 'País',t.vol AS 'Volume',t.bps AS 'Taxa média',t.pps AS 'Pacotes/s médio' FROM (SELECT src_asn AS asn,COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(src_asn_name,'')),'Não identificado') AS nome,COALESCE(NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT NULLIF(src_prefix,'') ORDER BY src_prefix SEPARATOR ', ' LIMIT 3),''),GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT src_ip ORDER BY src_ip SEPARATOR ', ' LIMIT 3)) AS blocos,COUNT(DISTINCT src_ip) AS ips,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS paises,MAX(NULLIF(src_country,'')) AS pais,SUM(total_bytes) AS vol,SUM(total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS bps,SUM(total_packets)/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS pps FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND src_asn>0 GROUP BY src_asn ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 20) AS t LEFT JOIN orby_country_names AS cn ON cn.code=t.pais ORDER BY t.vol DESC

SELECT protocol AS Protocolo,dst_port AS Porta,ROUND(SUM(total_bytes),0) AS 'Volume estimado' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc) AND dst_port>0 AND protocol IN ('tcp','udp') GROUP BY protocol,dst_port ORDER BY SUM(total_bytes) DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_bytes),0),0) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(bucket_utc)

spec.title: PPS estimados — média dos 5 min mais recentes

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_packets),0)/300,1) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND bucket_utc >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 90 MINUTE AND bucket_utc >= (SELECT MAX(bucket_utc) FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei') - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND bucket_utc < (SELECT MAX(bucket_utc) FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei')

spec.title: Taxa estimada — média dos 5 min mais recentes

spec.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_bytes),0)*8/300,3) AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei' AND bucket_utc >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 90 MINUTE AND bucket_utc >= (SELECT MAX(bucket_utc) FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei') - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND bucket_utc < (SELECT MAX(bucket_utc) FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute WHERE source='huawei')
